name: House Check
source:
Arlon and Owen are friends.

Arlon loves Owen.

Arlon makes sure Owen's comfort zone is always safe.

Which is why,

Arlon always makes sure he is updated on everything Owen does.

Including in his home.

[From [url=https://peridon.itch.io/house-check]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Arlon和Owen是朋友。

Arlon爱着Owen。

Arlon会确保Owen的舒适圈始终安全。

所以，

Arlon总要掌握Owen的一举一动。

包括他在家里做的事。

[摘自[url=https://peridon.itch.io/house-check]Itch.io[/url]]
